run_pybullet_mp4_recording: run a pybullet simulation that records an MP4 video of a falling R2D2 robot
connect_pybullet_gui_with_mp4: connect to pybullet GUI with MP4 recording options including width, height, and fps settings
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like plane and r2d2 into the pybullet physics simulation environment
configure_single_step_rendering: configure the pybullet debug visualizer to enable single step rendering for frame synchronization
step_simulation_loop: step through a pybullet simulation loop with debug text overlay and frame-by-frame rendering
